question_text: You are launching a boutique DTC functional beverage brand. Which positioning segment do you enter to escape the crowded Red Ocean?

game_config.takeaway: When 60% of entrants chase the largest headline segment (High-Caffeine Gym Pre-Workout), CAC skyrockets and margins collapse. Blue Ocean strategists capture outsized profit in viable, underserved niches.

options.text: 🧠 Caffeine-Free Evening Focus & Tart Cherry Nootropic
